NewsArticle.Title: Current Technical Status of Dark Ages
NewsArticle.Content:
Here is a brief update of some of the recent troubles in Dark Ages:
A glitch in the database for the web survey caused it to be unaccessible. This has been corrected and a new survey with a new link has been sent out.
There has been some techincal difficulties with the 'Free Week' service. Many first time players were unable to log onto the system. This problem has been corrected.
The "Free Week" will be ending either Monday or Tuesday, where registration will return. Nexon will not process credit card subscriptions via mail or fax, only by online registration. Nexon will continue to process check and money orders through the mail.
There will be a new client released within the month of July, the features of which will be listed in greater detail later on in the week.
